apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
spec:
  rules:
  - http:
      paths:
      - path: /api
        pathType: Prefix
      - path: /exact/one
      - path: "/quoted"
      - path: /docs/
      - path: /p/{id}

app.get('/api', h)
app.get('/api/users', h)
app.get('/apiary', h)
app.get('/exact/one', h)
app.get('/exact/one/two', h)
app.get('/docs/x', h)
app.get('/docs', h)
app.get('/quoted', h)
app.get('/internal/x', h)
app.get('/p/{id}/q', h)
app.get('/other', h)
app.get('/', h)
